show.description: When a disgraced billionaire heir Ray is publicly disowned at his own wedding, a composed stranger Julia steps in to marry him—hiding her own desperate secret. Trapped in a ruthless contract marriage, Julie must transform a reckless playboy into a worthy successor while concealing a pregnancy and a dark past. But as power games turn personal, control, desire, and revenge collide in Goa. Watch now!
